Initial release – adds actionable scarcity and urgency layers to any completed offer to boost conversions without altering the core offer.

- Provides guided question prompts to assess capacity, enrollment cycles, and prospect objections.
- Details proven scarcity types: business/client caps, growth-rate caps, cohort caps, and bonus-based scarcity with ethical enforcement rules.
- Outlines urgency strategies anchored in genuine timeline or promotion changes.
- Supplies word-for-word sales scripts, real-world usage tips, and an anti-pattern warning against fake scarcity/urgency.
- Integrates smoothly after offer creation and bonus/naming skills for a comprehensive launch stack.
